description: Full domain analysis: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME), WHOIS/RDAP registration data, inferred hosting provider and email service. No API keys needed. Use this when you need infrastructure-level intelligence about a company — who hosts them, what email provider they use, when the domain was registered, and what DNS configuration they have.

domain.description: Domain name without protocol (e.g. 'stripe.com', 'anthropic.com'). Must be a valid domain.
